metric: Euclidean nearest native vertex to one of 4733 authored floor-probe eyes, source Z + 1.65 m; an upper bound on nearest surface distance for those sampled eyes only.
caveat: These particular samples are shoulder probes. No independent full-body support/clearance certificate was run for either. Do not label them legal/clear cameras or continuous-route minima. Continuous component-envelope lower bounds are a distinct separately labeled metric.
correction: An early combined host foliage 1.7–1.8 m statement incorrectly generalized the framing result to the crown. The final family report separates 0.628999 m crown and 1.724844 m framing. No optimization relied on a safe distant threshold from either.
